mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate environment reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% for three consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that typically precedes corporate earnings deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and a rise in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) indicates a central bank's aggressive response to inflation, which typically leads to positive equity returns as the market prices in a strong economic recovery over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant: the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL rises.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending slowdown in manufacturing activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, INDPRO declines > 0.5% in 1 month are followed by positive 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO decline in late-cycle is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) reflects strong consumer confidence and economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates higher corporate revenues.
failure_condition: HOUST increases are followed by negative 5-day forward returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500.0 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals a cooling housing market that typically precedes reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1500.0 for 2 months is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a severe labor market contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in economic recession.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant: the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0 for two consecutive months, it signals a manufacturing slowdown that typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 95.0 for 2 months is followed by positive 5-day forward returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
